tables.name: users
tables.description: Authentication and user account information for all users (patients, doctors, admins).

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier for the user.

columns.name: email
columns.description: User email address, used for login and unique identification.

columns.name: password_hash
columns.description: Hashed password for authentication.

columns.name: role
columns.description: User role: patient, doctor, or admin.

columns.name: email_verified
columns.description: Indicates if the user's email has been verified.

columns.name: last_login
columns.description: Timestamp of the last successful login.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the user record was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the user record was last updated.

tables.name: patients
tables.description: Patient-specific profile information, linked to the users table.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier for the patient record.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Foreign key to users table, one-to-one relationship.

columns.name: first_name
columns.description: Patient's first name.

columns.name: last_name
columns.description: Patient's last name.

columns.name: date_of_birth
columns.description: Patient's date of birth.

columns.name: phone
columns.description: Patient's phone number.

columns.name: address
columns.description: Patient's residential address.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the patient record was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the patient record was last updated.

tables.name: doctors
tables.description: Doctor-specific profile information, linked to the users table.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier for the doctor record.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: Foreign key to users table, one-to-one relationship.

columns.name: first_name
columns.description: Doctor's first name.

columns.name: last_name
columns.description: Doctor's last name.

columns.name: license_number
columns.description: Professional medical license number.

columns.name: phone
columns.description: Doctor's phone number.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Doctor's contact email.

columns.name: bio
columns.description: Short biography or description of the doctor.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the doctor record was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the doctor record was last updated.

tables.name: specialties
tables.description: Medical specialties that doctors can have (e.g., Cardiology, Pediatrics).

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier for the specialty.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Name of the medical specialty.

columns.name: description
columns.description: Description of the specialty.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the specialty record was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the specialty record was last updated.

tables.name: doctor_specialties
tables.description: Junction table linking doctors to their specialties (many-to-many).

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier for the relation.

columns.name: doctor_id
columns.description: Foreign key to doctors table.

columns.name: specialty_id
columns.description: Foreign key to specialties table.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the relation was created.

tables.name: schedules
tables.description: Doctor's available time slots for appointments.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier for the schedule slot.

columns.name: doctor_id
columns.description: Foreign key to doctors table.

columns.name: start_time
columns.description: Start time of the available slot.

columns.name: end_time
columns.description: End time of the available slot.

columns.name: is_available
columns.description: Whether the slot is currently available for booking.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the schedule record was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the schedule record was last updated.

checks.description: End time must be after start time.

tables.name: appointments
tables.description: Patient appointments with doctors, linked to schedule slots.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier for the appointment.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Foreign key to patients table.

columns.name: doctor_id
columns.description: Foreign key to doctors table.

columns.name: schedule_id
columns.description: Foreign key to schedules table (the specific time slot).

columns.name: status
columns.description: Current status of the appointment: pending, confirmed, or cancelled.

columns.name: reason
columns.description: Reason for the appointment as provided by the patient.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Additional notes from the doctor or staff.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the appointment was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the appointment was last updated.

tables.name: medical_histories
tables.description: Patient medical history records, containing diagnoses, allergies, medications, etc.

columns.name: id
columns.description: Primary key, unique identifier for the medical history record.

columns.name: patient_id
columns.description: Foreign key to patients table.

columns.name: record_date
columns.description: Date of the medical record entry.

columns.name: diagnosis
columns.description: Diagnosis description.

columns.name: allergies
columns.description: Known allergies.

columns.name: medications
columns.description: Current medications.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: Additional notes from the healthcare provider.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the medical history record was created.

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Timestamp when the medical history record was last updated.
